concept: The place where content will be when there is none yet: a glyph in a small well, a title, one sentence and the way out.

default_to_avoid.pattern: an empty state with a large colourful illustration and a cheerful headline
default_to_avoid.kind: empty state, zero state, blank slate
default_to_avoid.why_not: an illustration owns colours of its own and a cheerful line says nothing; Pane names the missing thing and how to fill it

derivation.consequence: light falls from above, so every surface carries a rim brightest along its top edge and a soft shadow below that says where it floats, and a recess is the inverse, shaded under its top lip and lit on its bottom lip; a nested surface adds no second blur, because one sheet of glass is one layer
derivation.form: the glyph sits in a well carved like a field, a recess where the content will land

derivation.consequence: colour changes ease at the same pace as movement so the two read as one event
derivation.form: it brings no colour of its own, so the way out is the one loud thing on the pane

derivation.consequence: secondary text keeps the lowest opacity that still measured as passing; text halos count only where WCAG allows them
derivation.form: the title is the title size and the sentence keeps a reading measure so it reads as one short thought

options: A glyph in a well, title, way out
variants.picked: A glyph in a well, title, way out
variants.reason: A is a recess like Skeleton (P3) and leaves the action as the loud thing. B brings colour. C gives the eye nowhere to land.

root.why: the parts stack centred with even gaps and padding so the empty pane looks intended

sm.why: the small size trims the padding so it fits inside a card or a list without dominating

well.why: the glyph sits in a round well carved like a field, a recess where content will land

title.why: the title is semibold at the title size and is a heading at the level the page needs

description.why: the sentence is secondary and held to a reading measure so it stays one short block

actions.why: the way out sits apart from the text with room so the one loud button is clear

@media forced-colors: active.why: in forced colours the system draws the edges and the fill so the parts stay findable
